landform.shape: Dense small facets; thick turf and soil tongues, uneven skyline, stepped fractures, offset taper and irregular underside; protected structural pads and basin.

shoreline.method: Water recessed into the protected faceted basin; sheet edges extend underneath dry ground.

contacts.tree_geometry: Accepted sheltered tree geometry restored exactly; all left trees translated 0.43m, all right trees 0.41m to matching root pads.

references.title: Gunes Ozcan — 1st Low Poly Floating Island

direction: Thicker soil and grass; stronger fractures and irregular silhouette visible from far away, with smaller plentiful facets retained.
underside: One broad off-centre taper. The multiple bottom peaks in the reference are deliberately excluded.

final_visual_review.finding: Thick uneven turf/soil rim, angular rock fractures and one offset taper. Grounded trees, path, bridge and house contacts checked in surface/garden views; no exposed water-sheet edge observed in shoreline close-ups.
